answers.core: The shading language cannot be user-extended.
answers.workaround: Sometimes.  Workarounds depend on whether the data can fit into a supported uniform type such as Vec4, mat4 or similar.  A more generalized workaround involves glue code in a tool script which can generate an ImageTexture suitable to be bussed and decoded from a uniform Sampler2D within a given shader.

title: Support uniform arrays in the shader language
